svg.title: MagicFocus on a camera
svg.desc: Photo of a camera rig with MagicFocus, labelled. The M5Stack CoreS3 runs MagicFocus, with the Gateway H2 and DIN Base stacked under it. Beside it, the TFmini-S lidar is aimed where the lens points. The Tilta Nucleus Nano II motor beside the lens turns its focus ring. The lens is a Canon RF 24-70mm F2.8, a focus-by-wire lens.
svg.text: DIN Base are stacked under it
